text:
kevin: Kicking off Kepler Systems alpha HW preview. High-level ask: NDA signed, bench script validated, telemetry schema agreed, and a short ops runbook. Can we assign owners?
marta: I can drive the NDA counter-sign. I uploaded the draft from Kepler to the legal drive. Please don't run anything until countersign is complete.
yun: I'll own the bench harness. Plan: perf sweep (seq, batch), stability 4h, and a quick quant-mode comparison (fp16 vs q4/q5). Will tag runs with partner:Kepler.
fiona: Marketing note: embargo required until joint announcement signoff. We'll need logo usage + a 48h review window. Also ask product to draft marketplace metadata early.
kevin: Ops needs a minimal pre-checklist before any lab booking: NDA counter-signed, run_id, harness flag --anon_metrics, and ops ticket with node type.
yun: Harness example: ```
./kepler_bench --model rwd-13b-q4 --seq 1024 --batch 8 --iters 400 \n  --telemetry https://telemetry.redwood.internal/collect \n  --tags partner:Kepler,preview:alpha
```
yun: Telemetry fields we'll emit: model, variant, seq_len, batch_size, tokens_per_sec, p50_ms, p95_ms, p99_ms, vram_pct, run_id, partner. run_id must be stable UUID.
marta: Legal flagged a data clause: Kepler requests shared anonymized graphs for co-marketing. They asked for non-exclusive use. Sophia?
legal-bot: @marta @kevin Recommend amendment: "Redwood and Kepler may share aggregated, anonymized benchmark metrics for co-marketing, subject to mutual sign-off; raw traces will only be shared under a signed debug token for troubleshooting and will be deleted after 90 days unless otherwise agreed."
fiona: Good. Marketing will draft announcement checklist: NDA signed, perf report, design approvals, partner quote, embargo date. I'll own it.
yun: Added a flag --no-raw to the harness to prevent raw trace uploads by default. If we need debug traces, we'll generate a signed URL and short-lived token.
kevin: Ops can provision 1 x Kepler-GPU-XL on Fri afternoon once NDA is attached to ticket. I'll make the eng-infra ticket template now.
marta: Countersign expected EOD today. If done, schedule a dry-run Fri 15:00-17:00. Otherwise we push to Mon.
legal-bot: Action: attach countersigned NDA to #legal-partnerships and tag @sophia. Also ensure Section 5 (Data Use) reflects the agreed amendment.
yun: I'll upload a sample aggregated JSON payload to the drive and post link here after dry-run.
fiona: :thumbsup: Please keep me in loop for any numbers we might use in announcement.
kevin: Thanks everyone. Will update this thread after ops ticket is created and NDA is attached.
